no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: Evolus is a commercial-stage medical aesthetics company. Its two product lines are Jeuveau (botulinum toxin type A; FDA-approved 2019, supplied by Daewoong) and the Evolysse collection of injectable HA dermal gels (Form/Smooth FDA-approved Feb 2025; Sculpt PMA filed Aug 2025; Lips PMA in 2027; supplied by Symatese). All clinical trials supporting these products are completed. The Evolysse Sculpt/Lips/Eye products are aesthetic medical devices/HA gels in PMA review, not active P1/P2/P3 drug clinical trials. Per workflow rule #10, this is a commercial-stage / device-only firm without an active P1/P2/P3 drug pipeline.
